b: The much-anticipated Salesforce FIDE World Championship is about to start. This Tuesday, two stars from two of the world's strongest chess powerhouses will clash for the highest title in chess. On one side, Indian GM Gukesh Dommaraju will fight to defend his title. On the other, GM Javokhir Sindarov will strive to cap his meteoric rise by becoming the newest World Champion.

To celebrate this special occasion, we're giving everyone the chance to unlock exclusive World Championship flairs. Watch Chess.com's coverage of the Salesforce FIDE World Chess Championship between November 24 and December 12 to earn your drops!
The drops include two flairs, one for Gukesh and another for Sindarov. Watch two cumulative hours of the event's coverage to unlock your rewards and show your support for your favorite player:
To earn your exclusive flairs, you must first connect your Chess.com and Twitch accounts:

1. On the Account tab of your Settings page (web only), scroll down until you find the Connected Accounts option. From there, click the button to connect your Twitch account, then follow the instructions to complete the connection.
2. After connecting the accounts, you'll be eligible to receive the flairs. Watch two cumulative hours of any Salesforce FIDE World Championship broadcast to get them.

3. After watching the required stream time, go to your Twitch Drops & Rewards inventory page to claim your reward. You'll then see your new flairs on your Chess.com profile settings page. Note that the flairs might take a few minutes to show up on Chess.com.
